title: Test that listing tokens in the previous build's shapes are refused
outcome: Test that listing tokens in the previous build's shapes are refused
acceptance: A test rewrites a fresh listing token into each predecessor shape (a top-level cut field, a membership basis without observed_at, a project_cut basis without cut) and asserts each is refused as work_catalog_cursor_invalid
The boundary-millisecond and unrelated-note continuation tests assert the catalog-changed refusal reason, not any cursor refusal
